title: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones - Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1 - Safety Precautions

subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A technician is utilizing a soldering iron to replace a damaged charging flex. Which safety protocol must be implemented specifically to handle the byproducts of this tool?
options: Wearing an ESD band to prevent static
Ensuring adequate ventilation for soldering fumes
questions.explain: Soldering produces harmful chemical fumes from the flux and solder wire. Ensuring adequate ventilation is a critical safety protocol to prevent inhalation of these toxic byproducts.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When implementing anti-static precautions during motherboard repair, which equipment is standardly utilized according to safety procedures?
questions.explain: ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) bands or wrist straps are standard safety equipment worn by technicians to safely ground any static electricity and prevent it from discharging into sensitive microchips.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which specific battery technology is highlighted as a primary hazard regarding fires in mobile phone repairs?
questions.explain: Lithium-ion batteries are highly volatile if punctured, bent, or exposed to extreme heat, making them a primary fire and chemical hazard during mobile phone teardowns and repairs.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When extracting a damaged charging IC, a technician fails to use an ESD wrist strap. What invisible hazard could catastrophically damage the new IC before it is even soldered?
questions.explain: The human body naturally builds up static electricity. Without an ESD band to ground the technician, this static can discharge into sensitive logic board components (Electrostatic Discharge), destroying them instantly.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A technician accidentally punctures a mobile phone battery with sharp tweezers during a teardown, causing sudden extreme heat and smoke. This is an example of which safety hazard highlighted in the text?
questions.explain: Puncturing a Lithium-ion battery breaches the separator between the anode and cathode, causing an immediate internal short circuit that results in extreme heat, smoke, and often a dangerous chemical fire.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: What is the primary function of utilizing proper ventilation equipment during hardware repairs?
options: To clear dust from the LCD screen
To mitigate and clear soldering fumes
To keep the lithium-ion battery cool
questions.explain: During board-level repairs, the flux and solder used release toxic chemical fumes when heated. Proper ventilation equipment is necessary to extract these fumes and protect the technician's respiratory system.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: To prevent component destruction from microscopic electrical arcs caused by a technician's moving body, what should be worn?
questions.explain: An ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) band grounds the technician, ensuring that any static electricity generated by bodily movement is safely channeled away rather than arcing into and destroying delicate microchips.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: In the context of the prescribed safety protocols, how are Lithium-ion fires structurally categorized?
questions.explain: Lithium-ion batteries store a massive amount of dense energy. When mishandled, punctured, or exposed to excessive heat, they pose a severe battery hazard due to their tendency to ignite and cause chemical fires.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: What type of hazard do ESD bands primarily prevent?
questions.explain: ESD bands prevent the buildup of static electricity on a technician's body. Without this grounding, a sudden electrostatic discharge from a finger could easily fry the microscopic transistors inside a mobile phone.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: If a Lithium-ion fire starts during a repair due to an accidental puncture, what represents a severe hazard progression standard in battery emergencies?
questions.explain: Thermal runaway is a dangerous chemical chain reaction inside a lithium-ion battery where a fault causes the cell to heat up uncontrollably. This rapidly accelerates, leading to violent venting of smoke and a self-sustaining fire.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which action contradicts the recommended safety protocol when operating a hot air rework station and a soldering iron?
options: Opening a window or running an extractor fan
Closing all air vents to prevent dust entry
questions.explain: Soldering produces harmful smoke from vaporized flux. Closing air vents traps these toxic fumes in the workspace, directly violating essential ventilation safety protocols meant to protect the technician's lungs.
